findings.title: CHAR_FULL_NAMES import source unstated in component spec
findings.problem: The component renders characteristic steps with CHAR_FULL_NAMES[k] but does not name where it is imported from. The symbol lives in src/components/pages/characterConstants.ts (as used by AdvancementPage/AdvancementChecklist), not a shared logic module.
findings.fix: State in §7.2 that AdvancementPlanner imports CHAR_FULL_NAMES from './characterConstants', matching AdvancementChecklist.

findings.title: Talent timesTaken derivation for the priced suggestion not spelled out
findings.problem: The real handleAcquireTalent derives timesTaken via exact-name match (character.talents.find(t => t.n === name)?.lvl), while the owned-exclusion test uses startsWith matching. Both agree on timesTaken=0 (100 XP) for unowned current-level candidates, so there is no numeric divergence, but the design states the cost rule only as 'new talent -> 0 -> 100' without noting it mirrors the page's exact-name derivation.
findings.fix: Add one sentence to §6 'Talent': the suggested talent's timesTaken is computed exactly as the page does (character.talents.find(t => t.n === name)?.lvl ?? 0); since only unowned current-level talents are candidates, timesTaken is always 0 (100 XP in-career).
